invariants.text: One callId maps to one inbound session/call; a second callId is never minted for the same inbound call.
One decision has exactly one executable intent; the IVR never recomputes routing or selects another callee.
One call has at most one B-leg operation and one actual line request; unknown outcomes or restarts never cause a second dial.
One call has at most one reservation, one terminal settlement or release, and one usage fact.
The first accepted terminal fact is absorbed; terminal facts never regress; UNKNOWN converges only through reconciliation.
The (callId,purpose) decision is immutable; activation confirmation never rewrites the resolve decision.
The single-caller single-nonterminal-task rule and reciprocal task/call links remain A0 invariants.
Event identity is immutable; the same identity and fingerprint returns the first outcome, while changed content conflicts or quarantines.
Recording identity is immutable; declared facts never overwrite server-observed facts; completion never solidifies evidence.
The task path never asks for callee confirmation; the direct path never claims a task; there is no latest-callee fallback.
Heartbeat never changes business state, never releases a reservation, never authorizes a call and never triggers redial.
No protocol output, log, audit or outbox exposes a plaintext callee or an object key, URL or credential.
The protocol version is frozen at resolve; an unsupported version fails before side effects; a call never upgrades mid-call.
Every unknown outcome fails closed without redial, double reservation, double settlement or contradictory facts.
Declaration and completion retries reuse recordingId and never create a second recording or media object.
